headline: Turn drone imagery into
timeline.sub: A walkthrough of the live platform
timeline.narration: G20 Tech turns drone imagery into decisions. Follow one survey, start to finish.

captions.title: One workspace per organization
captions.text: Projects, processing tasks and their status at a glance.

captions.title: A reusable dataset library
captions.text: Upload a flight once, then process it as often as needed.

timeline.narration: Each organization gets its own workspace: projects, tasks and their status. Flights are stored as reusable datasets: upload once, process as often as needed.

captions.title: Geotagged source imagery
captions.text: 68 photos from one flight, each with its GPS position and capture time.

timeline.narration: This dataset is a single flight: sixty-eight photos, each carrying its GPS position and capture time.

captions.title: From photos to survey products
captions.text: This run turned 68 photos into a 5 cm per pixel orthophoto.

captions.title: New task: drop images, pick a preset
captions.text: Ground control and every engine option are there when needed.

timeline.narration: Processing runs on the OpenDroneMap engine, managed from the browser. This task turned those photos into a five-centimetre orthophoto, elevation models, a point cloud and a 3D model. A new task needs only images and a preset.

timeline.title: Visualization
timeline.sub: Maps, elevation and 3D, in the browser

captions.title: The orthophoto, on the map
captions.text: One georeferenced image of the site, with every camera position and the flight path.

captions.title: From site overview to 5 cm per pixel
captions.text: Over street, satellite or topographic basemaps.

timeline.narration: Open the task and the orthophoto is on the map, with each camera position and the flight path. Switch the basemap for context, then zoom from the whole site down to five centimetres per pixel.

captions.title: Digital Surface Model
captions.text: Heights of buildings, trees and ground. Blend it over the imagery.

captions.title: Digital Terrain Model
captions.text: The bare-earth surface, with structures and vegetation removed.

timeline.narration: Elevation comes too. The surface model shows buildings and trees; blend it over the imagery, or switch to bare-earth terrain.

captions.title: Measure directly on the survey
captions.text: Outline any feature for distance, area or volume.

captions.title: Volume and footprint in one step
captions.text: Computed from the surface model inside the outline.

timeline.narration: Measurement happens on the map. Outline a building and the platform returns its footprint and its volume, computed from the surface model.

captions.title: Textured 3D model
captions.text: Rotate, zoom and pan the reconstruction. Nothing to install.

timeline.narration: The same survey as a textured 3D model. Rotate it, zoom in, pan across it, right in the browser, with nothing to install.

captions.title: A 10-million-point cloud, streamed
captions.text: Detail loads progressively as you move.

captions.title: Colour by elevation or by class
captions.text: Ground, vegetation and buildings are told apart.

captions.title: Elevation profile along any line
captions.text: Ground and surface heights, length and grade. Export as CSV.

timeline.narration: For full detail there is the point cloud: ten million points, streamed as you move. Colour it by elevation, or by class: ground, vegetation, buildings. Draw a line across the site and read off an elevation profile.

timeline.title: AI Analysis
timeline.sub: Detection and change measurement on any survey

captions.title: Run an AI model on any survey
captions.text: Pick a detector: tree crowns, or vehicles and people.

timeline.narration: Analysis plugins bring AI to every survey. Here, a detector for vehicles and people.

captions.title: 184 objects found on this site
captions.text: 137 cars, 20 vans, 20 pedestrians and more, each one georeferenced.

captions.title: Every detection is map data
captions.text: Class, confidence and footprint, downloadable as GeoJSON.

timeline.narration: The result comes back as map data: one hundred and eighty-four objects on this site, each with a class and a confidence score, ready to download.

captions.title: Change detection between two surveys
captions.text: Cut and fill regions, measured from the elevation models.

captions.title: Volumes with their uncertainty
captions.text: Demo input: two processing runs of one flight. 0.5% of the site is flagged.

captions.title: Every region carries its numbers
captions.text: Area, volume with uncertainty, and height change.

timeline.narration: Change detection compares two surveys of one site and reports cut and fill volumes with their uncertainty. In this demo both inputs are runs of the same flight, so it finds almost nothing: half a percent of the site.

timeline.title: Actionable Insights
timeline.sub: Standard files and an open analysis layer

captions.title: Deliverables in standard formats
captions.text: Cloud-optimized GeoTIFF rasters, a LAZ point cloud and a GLB model.

timeline.narration: Results leave the platform in standard formats: cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs, a LAZ point cloud and a GLB model.

captions.title: Analysis is pluggable
captions.text: Detection, change, contours, hillshade and segmentation, enabled per organization.

captions.title: A marketplace for new capabilities
captions.text: Plugins are versioned, licensed and installed per organization.

timeline.narration: The analysis layer is open. Plugins are enabled per organization and distributed through a built-in marketplace, so new models arrive without changing the platform.

headline: From flight to decision,
notes: Every screen in this video was recorded from the running platform.
Sample survey datasets are shown for demonstration.
timeline.narration: Drone data, processing, visualization, AI analysis, insight. One platform, from flight to decision.
